title: READOUT: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with Minister of Finance and National Revenue François-Philippe Champagne of Canada
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Canadian Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne on April 19, 2026, discussing the Iran conflict, energy markets, critical minerals collaboration, the upcoming USMCA review, and cooperation on drug trafficking-related illicit financing. This is a diplomatic readout providing only general discussion topics with no specific policy announcements, economic data, or concrete commitments.
key_points: Secretary Bessent and Minister Champagne discussed the conflict with Iran
Meeting covered energy markets and critical minerals collaboration
Both officials stressed strengthening the U.S.-Canada bilateral relationship
Discussions aimed at building momentum ahead of the USMCA review
Secretary encouraged Canada to assist with Trump administration efforts on drug trafficking-related illicit financing
No specific policy commitments, economic figures, or actionable outcomes were disclosed
